Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing small appurtenances on recreational vehicles.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to recreational vehicle appurtenances; and addinga new section to chapter 46.44 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.44 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Motor homes, travel trailers, and campers may exceed the maximumwidth established under RCW 46.44.010 if the excess width isattributable to appurtenances that do not extend beyond the body of thevehicle by more than four inches, or if an awning, by more than sixinches. As used in this section, "appurtenance" means an appendagethat is installed by a factory or a vehicle dealer and is intended asan integral part of the motor home, travel trailer, or camper."Appurtenance" does not include an item temporarily affixed or attachedto the exterior of a vehicle for the purpose of transporting the itemfrom one location to another. "Appurtenance" does not include an itemthat obstructs the driver's rearward vision.
